title: MobQA: A Benchmark Dataset for Semantic Understanding of Human Mobility Data through Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing evaluation scores of model-generated free-form answers using LLM judges from different model families (Gemini-2.0-Flash vs. GPT-4o) and calculating Pearson and Spearman correlation coefficients to ensure the judge does not unfairly favor responses generated by its own model family.
